author: EmuCore - Hub
title: DuckStation NEW Complete Graphics Guide | Best Settings PS1 Tutorial
summary: Warped Polygon's DuckStation graphics walkthrough distinguishes PS1 image enhancements from the hardware behavior they alter.
searchKeywords: DuckStation NEW Complete Graphics Guide | Best Settings PS1 Tutorial

blocks.text: This guide tours DuckStation's graphics options with a focus on the old PlayStation's characteristic image. Higher internal resolution, texture filtering and geometry corrections can address visible artifacts, but they do not all solve the same problem. The video gives a starting point for seeing each control in context, and its description links related demonstrations of shaders, texture replacement and overclocking. Those are separate choices and should not be combined before a baseline is recorded.

A good comparison uses the same game revision and camera position, first at defaults and then with one enhancement enabled. Watch polygons, fixed-size interface art, dithering and motion rather than relying on a single still image. Some effects are intentional consequences of the original hardware and may look different when enhanced. The recording is a practical menu guide, not evidence that the highest setting is most accurate or that every game benefits equally.
